rapport_notes: Careful and patient clarifying scope on a piano-and-bunk-bed move across two pickup locations.

evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: if ever that move takes less than this, then you will only be charged for how much time you use during the move

coaching_note: No damage-coverage or on-time-guarantee mention anywhere in an eleven-plus-minute call moving a piano and multiple beds — high-value items are exactly when naming the $2,000 coverage builds confidence.
